title: Several tasks at once in the built chat: a message with several asks runs them together, a plot alongside an improvement run
request: Several tasks at once on the board, for example improve and plot in parallel.
spec: The built chat's rules plan (draft/orchestrator.plan) and HomeGuard; studio/improve.py's saves.
plan: plan() reads a message part by part when it asks for several things; at most 3 tasks and one offer.
"yes, and ..." carries out the offer and the rest.
A notebook cell is written while an improvement runs; a stage run still blocks it.

decisions.decision: Only light work runs beside an improvement (a notebook cell); a second improvement or a stage waits.
decisions.why: The Mac has 8 GB; two model trainings at once would slow both.

decisions.decision: A cell may be written during an improvement run, not during a stage run.
decisions.why: The improvement job reads the project just before each save; a stage run holds it for minutes and saves it whole.

decisions.decision: Building is never carried by "yes, and ...".
decisions.why: Building spends and creates a project: it needs a plain yes.

change: dclab_rnd/draft/orchestrator.py (plan wrapper, SPLIT, YES_AND, ALONGSIDE_IMPROVE), tests/test_home_orchestrator.py, studio/improve.py and jobs/handlers.py (field updates), studio/store.py (a file lock across processes)

findings.defect: "yes, and plot it" ran only the plot.
findings.cause: A yes followed by words was not a yes.
findings.fix: YES_AND offers take the yes and plan the rest.

findings.defect: A data change in one part of a message was lost.
findings.scenario: "add column a = spend * 2 and plot the spend".
findings.cause: Only splittable tools and reads were kept from parts.
findings.fix: propose_data_change kept too, one offer a turn.

findings.defect: A joined copy of a later outcome stayed in the new version.
findings.scenario: join plans(plan, churned_60d, price), yes, then change the outcome to churned_60d.
findings.cause: The joined column was renamed plans_churned_60d and only renamed names were compared.
findings.fix: _reads includes the joined table's own column names.

findings.scenario: "right, but show me the leakage first" confirmed a problem change; "yes but plot the roc curve instead" started a job.
findings.cause: Any yes with two more words ran the offer.
findings.fix: Only "yes and/then/also ...", and nothing that holds it back (but, instead, first, not now).

findings.defect: A plot made better started a model improvement.
findings.scenario: "plot spend by month, and make it look better" submitted an improve job.
findings.cause: A part's IMPROVE and DOING words.
findings.fix: From a part, an improvement only when it names the model.

findings.defect: "yes, and add column ..." lost the yes.
findings.scenario: After a proposed problem change: the change expired, the data change was proposed.
findings.cause: The tail kept only reads and splittable tools.
findings.fix: propose_data_change and remember are kept after the yes.

findings.defect: A cell written beside an improvement run could still be lost, and the job's fields overwritten.
findings.scenario: The worker gets the project, the chat writes a cell, the worker saves the whole document.
findings.cause: improve.run and the job handler saved whole documents; the file store's lock was per process.
findings.fix: They update their own fields; the file store also takes a file lock across processes.
findings.test: tests/test_home_orchestrator.py (a second process holds the lock)

measurements.name: affected tests
measurements.result: home orchestrator 65, jobs 18, improve 3, storage contract 25 on both backends
limits: the model path plans its own calls; only the rules' plan was changed

outcome: A person can ask for several things in one message and see them on one board; a plot is written while the model improves.
lessons: Before allowing work in parallel, read how each long job saves: the risk is a whole-document save over minutes.
risks: The split is by words; an ask joined by a bare "and" without a verb stays one ask.
